headline:
The Fed didn't cut.
Three governors wanted
[[to raise rates instead]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: Waiting for relief just got riskier than buying.

stats.label: The Fed has paused five times in 2026 without a single rate cut.
Three governors voted against the pause and pushed for a rate hike instead.
The next meeting could bring the first hike of this cycle, not a cut.
